title: Last Vegas
description: Aging friends (Michael Douglas, Robert De Niro, Morgan Freeman) head to Las Vegas to celebrate the end of one's long bachelorhood and relive their glory days.

title: A Night at the Roxbury
description: Desperate to meet women and open their own dance club, brainless brothers Steve (Will Ferrell) and Doug Butabi (Chris Kattan) cruise Beverly Hills.

title: The Ladies Man
description: A late-night radio host and self-described Casanova (Tim Meadows) searches for a lost love when he receives an unsigned letter boasting of her wealth.

title: I Love You, Man
description: As a bridegroom's bond with his new best friend grows, it threatens his relationship with his fiancée.

title: She's Out of My League
description: An airport security agent must figure out how to make the relationship work when a beautiful, successful woman falls in love with him.

title: What Women Want
description: A chauvinistic executive has an accident and can suddenly hear what women think.

title: No Strings Attached
description: After sex enters the equation, two lifelong friends (Natalie Portman, Ashton Kutcher) make a pact to keep their relationship purely physical.

title: Jersey Girl
description: A young woman (Liv Tyler) changes the life of a single father (Ben Affleck) who used to be a successful New York music publicist.

title: The Boss's Daughter
description: A 40-year-old workshop foreman falls for the daughter of his boss, and nobody approves of the relationship.

title: Evolution
description: Chaos ensues when a meteor hits the Earth carrying alien life forms that give new meaning to the term survival of the fittest.

title: Dinner for Schmucks
description: Comic misadventures follow when a rising executive (Paul Rudd) brings a blundering IRS agent (Steve Carell) to a monthly gathering hosted by his boss.

title: Dickie Roberts: Former Child Star
description: Hoping to make a comeback, a man (David Spade) stays with a suburban family to prepare for the lead role in a Rob Reiner film.

title: The Tuxedo
description: A chauffeur (Jackie Chan) embarks on a covert mission after a tuxedo from a secret agent (Jason Isaacs) gives him extraordinary abilities.

title: Black Sheep
description: A beautiful girl (Ximena Romo) complicates matters between an orphaned shepherd (Christian Vázquez) and his rival (Iván Arana).
